Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare
Job Description: 
 DB Global Technology is Deutsche Bank’s technology centre in Central and Eastern Europe. Since its set-up in 2013, Bucharest Technology Centre (BEX) has constantly proven its capacity to deliver global technology products and services, playing a dynamic role in the Bank’s technology transformation.
 We have a robust, hands-on engineering culture dedicated to continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, technical skill development and networking. We are an essential part of the Bank’s technology platform and develop applications for many important business areas.
 Responsibilities 
Collaborate with finance business users to understand their Financial Reporting needs, KPIs, and data analysis requirements. 
Design and implement robust, scalable data models in SAP BW using HANA objects (e.g., ADSOs, Composite Providers, InfoObjects, HANA Views) that accurately represent financial data structures and business logic.
Develop and manage ETL processes to extract financial data from various source systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, non-SAP sources), apply necessary transformations (using ABAP routines), and load it into BW.
Developing custom ABAP objects like Start, End, and Expert routines within BW Transformations to perform complex data manipulations, calculations, or validations, especially for financial-specific rules and mappings.
Extracting financial data from the SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA) using modern extraction methods, such as ABAP Core Data Services (CDS) views.
Create and optimize BW BEx querie & BO Webi reports. Building efficient BW Queries (the modern name for BEx Queries) to provide aggregated and detailed financial data for end-user reporting.
Develop, and publish various financial reports and interactive dashboards using BusinessObjects tools (Web Intelligence) or SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
Analyze and optimize the performance of BW data loads, queries, and BO reports to ensure fast and efficient access to critical financial information.
Monitoring data load times, optimizing query execution plans using transaction RSRT, and configuring database-level settings for performance improvement.
Creating, scheduling, and monitoring process chains, managing delta loads for finance data, and implementing error handling for data load failures.
Create comprehensive technical documentation for data models, ETL processes, reports, and security configurations, and provide training to end-users or support teams.
 Skills 
Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university with a concentration in Science or an IT-related discipline (or equivalent)
5-8+years of development experience across SAP BO & BW
Serve as a technical expert for SAP BO reports, providing end-user training, and documenting technical specifications.
Proficiency in the SAP BusinessObjects BI Suite, including Web Intelligence (WebI), Crystal Reports, and Information Design Tool (IDT). Experience in BO platform upgrade & CMC
Working experience with Finance industry is preferred Good communication and team player
Experience in Agile delivery as a squad member
 Well-being & Benefits 
 Emotionally and mentally balanced: we support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health 
Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness.
A professional, passionate, and fun workplace with flexible Work from Home options.
A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.
Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts.
 Physically thriving we support you managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive 
Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones.
 Socially connected: we strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and wellbeing. 
Kids@TheOffice - support for unexpected events requiring you to care for your kids during work hours.
Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, employee sport clubs, workshops, and more.
 Financially secure: : we support you to meet personal financial goals during your active career and for the future 
Competitive income, performance-based promotions, and a sense of purpose.
24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays).
